info.description: 3rd-party integration collection. Set the {{baseUrl}} and {{apiKey}} (or {{jwt}}) collection variables in Postman before running. See /docs/INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md and /api/docs for the interactive reference.

variable.description: Webhook verify token, from the WhatsApp settings page.

item.name: Update case (recalculates sale premium if confirmed)

request.description: Admin JWT (or API key owned by admin) + sales:payment. Marks the sale as Paid.
Admin only. Unchecking Paid is limited to 2 occurrences per policy (payment_reverse_count). Audited in Activity Log.
Admin JWT only. Returns canonical soft-delete reasons.
Admin JWT only. Policy remains visible with premium/commission 0. Reasons: Test policy | Customer desistement | Error or duplicate | Cancellation before reversal.
JSON payload for the printable certificate. contact includes generalLine, centralAfricaLine (Central Africa calls/WhatsApp), whatsapp, emergencyHelpline, websiteUrl.
Returns sale lines with commission / net_to_transfer (same rules as partner invoices) and meta.summary: totalPolicies, totalCommissions, netToTransfer.

item.name: Agents (admin / sub-admin JWT)
item.description: Agency-management endpoints. JWT only — no API-key scope grants access. Uses {{jwt}}. Includes admin-only reassignment (PATCH …/supervisor) and supervision history (GET …/supervision-history).

request.description: Admin JWT only. Moves a top-level partner/agency to another sub-admin (or admin). Policies, policy numbers, identifiers and agency codes are retained. Writes agency_supervision_history periods.
Admin JWT only. Management periods by date for the agency (e.g. Mar–Apr Admin, from May Sub-Admin Esther).
Admin JWT only. Scopes the account to catalogue plans with matching partner_insurer (e.g. gna → GNA Retail / Inbound / Road).

item.name: Users (JWT)
item.description: Self-service profile / dashboard for the logged-in user. Uses {{jwt}}.

item.name: Reconciliation (JWT)
item.description: Monthly agent reconciliation. Each row includes agency_name (travel agency) and sub_admin_name (sales rep). Uses {{jwt}}.

item.name: Partner invoices (admin / sub-admin JWT)
item.description: Partner premium invoices and Paid-only receipts. PDF header: Assur'Assistance + GNA logos. Optional saleIds, discountPct, documentType (invoice|receipt), stamp (none|paid|settled). Accept-Language localizes labels/stamps. Agico → commission 0. Uses {{jwt}}.

query.description: Comma-separated sale ids to include; omit for all
XOF | USD | EUR — convert from each sale's currency (Agico often USD)

item.name: Partner receipt PDF (Paid only + PAID stamp)

query.description: receipt = Paid policies only (400 if none)
none | paid | settled — localized via Accept-Language
Must be Paid; unpaid lines are dropped

item.name: Contractual documents (JWT)
item.description: Terms & Conditions (full / brief). Any JWT lists and downloads. Admin JWT uploads/replaces (multipart title + description + file).

item.name: Quotes
item.description:
Pricing as an endpoint. /quotes/price stores nothing; /quotes persists the result as a case awaiting payment, which the existing confirm-sale flow turns into a policy.

Scopes: quotes:read for pricing and reads, quotes:write to store.

request.description: Destination zone -> validity tier -> age band. Requires quotes:read.
Omit plan_id to price everything the caller may sell, cheapest first. Plans that could not be priced come back in `rejected` with a reason.
Under 16 halves the premium. Over 85 returns 422 age_ineligible instead of a price.
Requires quotes:write. The premium is recalculated from the live catalogue at this moment, never taken from the request. Returns a QT- reference and a case in AwaitingPayment.
An API key sees only quotes owned by its own account.
Returns the stored inputs plus a pricing block recomputed from today's catalogue, so a moved price is visible. Another account's reference returns 404, not a hint that it exists.

item.name: Destination zones
item.description:
Country to pricing-zone map. A country's zone selects a column in each plan's rate table.

All 195 countries ship in a single 'Worldwide' zone, so pricing is unchanged until a real map is supplied. Read with zones:read; only a superadmin JWT may reassign.

request.description: Zones in use, with country counts.
Every country with its zone, in English and French.
Accepts an ISO code or a name in either language, fuzzy-matched.

item.name: Reassign countries to a zone (admin JWT)

request.description: An update of one column: no country is created or removed, and unrecognised codes are returned in data.unknown.

item.name: WhatsApp
item.description:
The conversational purchase channel.

The webhook is authenticated by Meta's X-Hub-Signature-256 over the RAW body, not by a bearer token, and is not usefully callable from Postman without a valid signature.

Transcripts contain personal data, so reading them needs whatsapp:read rather than cases:read.

request.description: Meta's one-time handshake. Echoes hub.challenge as plain text when the verify token matches.
Non-secret status: enabled, ready, default language.
Filter by status, or search by number, profile name or quote reference.
Includes the step the customer is on and the data collected so far.
Inbound and outbound messages, oldest first. Subject to the retention policy.
Customer messages per completed purchase, against the 6-8 target.
Requires whatsapp:write.
Deletes transcripts older than the configured window. Never touches a session, case, traveller or sale.

item.name: Admin — WhatsApp settings
item.description:
Superadmin configuration. Admin JWT ONLY — an API key can never reach these endpoints, whatever scopes it holds.

Credentials are stored AES-256-GCM encrypted; the master key lives only in SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY. Saved changes take effect without a restart.

request.description: Secrets come back masked, never in clear. status.ready says whether the integration can send and receive right now.
Omit a secret, or send "", to leave the stored value untouched. Send null to clear it.
Live Graph API check: the token is valid, it can access this phone number id, and the number is usable.
Returned once in clear so it can be pasted into Meta. Regenerating breaks the connection until Meta is updated too.
The one secret that can be read back, because the operator must copy it into Meta. Every reveal is written to the activity log.
Accounts that can own WhatsApp-originated business. A WhatsApp customer has no agent, but commissions, partner invoices and the ledger are all keyed to one.
